title: VAT returns only digital now
description: From 8 April 2021 all VAT returns have to be filled using the MTD connection.
author: Barry Adams
html:
On 8 April 2021, HMRC retired its facility to file VAT returns using XML software and only allows filing through the MTD (Making Tax Digital) connection.

With FreeAgent, this option is available to all our clients, as long as you have set up your MTD connection. So if you haven't done that yet, and you are VAT registered, now is the perfect time to sort this out.

For more information on Making Tax Digital, we'd like to refer you to this excellent guide on the FreeAgent website.

We are of course here to help you with any of this, so if you would like some assistance or talk through your options, just get in touch and we'll be happy to help.
